before: Which of the ancient bishops dishonored Christ by painting him? Which of them made a public example of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, of Moses and the prophets, of Peter or Andrew or James or John or the rest of the apostles, and paraded them in triumph in this way? before: For the very thing they fashion from their own thought, they are lying about. The deceivers paint the holy apostle Peter as an old man, with his head and beard shorn. They also paint Saint Paul—some as bald in front, others as bald with a beard—and the other disciples as simply shorn. If the Savior had long hair while the other disciples were shorn, and he was not shorn yet appeared the same as them, then why were the Pharisees and scribes giving thirty pieces of silver to Judas for payment, so that after kissing him he might point out to them, “This is the one you are looking for”? Could they not have found him by themselves or through others, by the sign of the long hair, without giving a reward?
